name: Sendbird
description: Sendbird is a communications platform for embedding chat, messaging, calls, support, moderation, and notifications into customer-owned applications.
agentUseSummary: Sendbird cannot currently be connected as a Relay-owned account integration because its Platform API uses customer application master or secondary API tokens rather than delegated OAuth. The master token is immutable and irrevocable, secondary-token lifecycle operations require that master token, and end-user access/session tokens authorize users inside one customer application rather than delegated account administration.

blocked.label: Connect a Sendbird account
blocked.description: Sendbird does not publish a distributable delegated account OAuth, consent, callback, refresh, or revocation lifecycle for third-party Relay connections.

blocked.label: Custody a master API token
blocked.description: A customer application's master token cannot be changed or revoked and must not be requested or stored by Relay.

blocked.label: Manage a secondary API token
blocked.description: Secondary tokens provide broad application API access and can be listed, generated, or revoked only with the excluded master token.

blocked.label: Relabel a user token as OAuth
blocked.description: Chat access and session tokens authenticate end users inside a customer's own application and are not delegated authority over the Sendbird account or application.

blocked.label: Access Sendbird application data
blocked.description: Channels, users, messages, announcements, moderation, notifications, calls, settings, files, exports, and every application or organization read/write remain unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported delegated account contract or a separately approved user-owned secondary-token product decision.

runtimeSupport.description: No supported delegated Sendbird account contract is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No supported delegated Sendbird account contract is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Sendbird documents customer application API tokens rather than delegated account OAuth. The master token is immutable and irrevocable, and only it can manage or revoke broad secondary tokens.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Sendbird credentials or show Connect. Reconsider only after Sendbird publishes a distributable delegated account contract, or after a separate product/security decision approves a user-owned secondary-token integration whose master-token setup and revocation remain outside Relay.

evidence.supports: Sendbird documents an Application ID plus master or secondary Api-Token for server-side Platform API requests, and states that the master token cannot be changed or revoked.
Sendbird describes master and secondary application tokens, secure server-side storage, and rotation, not delegated account OAuth.
Sendbird requires the master API token to generate a broadly capable secondary API token.
Sendbird states that only the master token can revoke secondary tokens and that the master itself cannot be revoked.
Sendbird session tokens authenticate a user inside a Sendbird application; they are not delegated account authorization for Relay.
